Needed a new GameLoop.OnBodySpawned seam because Boot spawns the body while HeldWeapon (which dresses it) is built by the adapter. (2) foot.js:1041-1048 resume()'s retry: ported as a fallback ladder (saved id -> race default -> banana) because a literal re-lookup of a wired prefab reference cannot change answer, plus the Georgian failure hint verbatim, with Mode left in the aeroplane.
